_about: Two-arm-car test (2026-11-14): a few blocks on the floor, cars A and B each bring ONE block to the arena edge. A missed grab is tried again, up to 5 misses in a row, then that car gives up and goes home. Use with: python -m antcolony.coordinator --overlay profiles/edge2.json --arena-from-tags

deliver._mode: edge = put objects down at the arena boundary (no bin). An object lying within edge_zone of the boundary counts as delivered and is never picked up.
deliver._inset: the arm puts the object down this far inside the boundary (metres)
deliver._y_z: drop skill: reach 16 cm ahead of the arm base, fingertips 4 cm above the floor, then open

pick._give_up: park = after max_tries misses in a row the car stops for good; next = it may take another object

triage._why: the overhead camera over-estimates small blocks; do not let a size guess stop a grab in this test

control._why: measured 2026-11-14: the arm cars cover 30 cm/s at command 0.3 and turn 70-125 deg/s at the smallest turn command; the simulator's cars are about 4x slower. Keep the commands low until the controller has been tuned on the real cars.
